transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I'm coming in today because I've been losing a lot of weight recently. Honestly, I've barely been eating anything lately, sometimes just a bite or two of food a day.
Are you avoiding food because you’re afraid of gaining weight or because you feel your body is too large, even though others may say you’re thin?

Yes, the thought of gaining even a little bit of weight completely terrifies me. Everyone keeps telling me I'm too skinny, but when I look in the mirror, I still feel like I need to keep losing weight.
Besides your weight, do you spend a lot of time worrying about a specific part of your appearance that you feel looks defective or ugly?
No, I don't really worry about other specific parts of my appearance being ugly or defective. My anxiety is strictly focused on my weight and the intense fear of gaining any.
Have you been doing anything to prevent weight gain, like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?
No, I don't do any of those things. I've never made myself throw up, used laxatives, or done any excessive exercising to keep my weight down. I just focus on strictly limiting how much food I eat.
